runs.title: Heading step 90 deg (rudder saturation)
runs.objective: Verify response when the rudder hits its +/-35 deg limit

checks.text: The autopilot shall settle within 2 deg of a commanded heading change within 45 s.
Heading overshoot shall not exceed 10% of the commanded change.
Rudder commands shall never exceed the +/-35 deg mechanical limit.

runs.title: Heading sensor dropout mid-turn
runs.objective: Verify fault detection, safe mode, and recovery after a 6 s compass loss

checks.text: Rudder commands shall never exceed the +/-35 deg mechanical limit.
Loss of the heading sensor shall be flagged within 0.5 s.
During and after a heading sensor loss, the vessel shall not deviate more than 15 deg past the commanded course.
After the heading sensor returns, heading shall be back within 2 deg of the setpoint within 45 s.
